ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 12

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

7. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 72
   D. 17

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

9. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
